decision: Reject the proposed guard for production. It improves one neural-mask flower fit but regresses the existing Hunodan quality and runtime control. Preserve the original production ranking and all acceptance gates.

screen.scope: 78 unique targets from 26 fixed crops plus six unresolved photos; repeated targets and unresolved method references are retained separately. 63 fully observed targets eligible, 15 observation-weighted targets outside the changed policy. The second screen adds exact duplicate-run score validation and retains the original deadline-truncated fit.

observations: The guard restores a recognizable six-petal flower in the residual-trained mask, but false channels, warped petals and border defects remain.
The untriggered joint-trained residual mask remains similar; both methods lose two features. The joint-readout mask remains severely distorted.
On hjfig-05 the guarded candidate has visibly rougher edges, thin false seams and six cuts per sheet versus the baseline four.

limitations: Post-hoc development investigation of already inspected data; not unseen-source NN generalization.
A fixed-work screen of unchanged masks does not establish robustness on arbitrary perturbations.
The fresh flower comparison covers one photograph, not three independent designs.
Timed fits can differ even when the policy does not trigger; no best-of-repeated-run selection.
Targets are derived photographic masks, not original artwork or cutting-path ground truth.
The Hunodan counterexample is sufficient to reject this guard; its two candidates did not receive an additional editable-export study after the independent quality regression was established.
rootCause: Sorting candidates also changes early feature initialization and routing allocation. On hjfig-05, restoring the lower-error four-cut grid starts feature initialization, cuts the routing attempt to 0.75 seconds and defers the remaining routing. The unchanged solver instead funds about 6.44 seconds of routing and recovers a four-cut pair. The guarded search refines a six-cut grid for longer and produces worse exported fidelity. A local image-error preference is not an independent scheduling change.

resources.scope: Five fit/review/export directories, unique inodes; excludes small standalone screen/log files.
